content.title: Public Storage-led consortium abandons $1.4 billion pursuit for Australia's Abacus Storage
content.summary: Abacus said its independent board committee was notified overnight that the consortium had withdrawn its proposal.  The firm did not disclose any reason behind the consortium's withdrawal.  The deal, which was first announced in April, had the consortium offering Abacus shareholders A$1.47 per stapled security for all shares not currently held by Ki Corp and its subsidiaries.
